descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Miami puts you in the captain's seat over the real Miami.

THE REAL MIAMI
Built from real aerial photography and real map data: the turquoise water of Biscayne Bay and the reef, Miami Beach and South Beach, Key Biscayne and the lighthouse, the cruise ships at the Port, the Downtown and Brickell towers, the stadium, the ballpark and the Everglades on the horizon. Five airports: Miami International, Fort Lauderdale, Homestead, Opa-locka and Miami Executive.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your own glass hangar on Watson Island, with the skyline across the bay at golden hour. Walk around your aircraft, repaint them, power wash them clean, then choose one and fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with glass cockpits, side-sticks and cabins you can get up and walk through in flight, a cozy midsize jet with yokes and a club cabin, and a twin-engine supersonic fighter with a bubble canopy.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Eleven missions: landings at Miami and Homestead, a hop up the beaches to Fort Lauderdale, a ring run up Miami Beach, a skyline run along the bayfront, a low pass down the reef, a fighter scramble, a night city run and a Miami tour - or just fly, by day, at sunset or at night.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a 4-digit code. Join up on a friend's wing or ride in their aircraft. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
